name: Orihara Shino
source: Mother of Akeno, and the person in charge of the Basilisk's test voyage. She is the one that invites Kyousuke and his friends on the ship. A very accepting and generous woman.
translation: Mother of Akeno, and the person in charge of the Basilisk's test voyage. She is the one that invites Kyousuke and his friends on the ship. A very accepting and generous woman.
